blocks.text: Minerals inorganic maadde hain jo jaandaron ke liye zaroori tabeei-kimiyai amal barqarar rakhne ko chahiye. Yeh tawanai nahi dete, lekin bohat si sargarmiyon mein in ke ahem kaam hain. Minerals macro (bare) anasir aur micro (trace) anasir mein taqseem hote hain.

items: Macro-minerals mein calcium, phosphorus, sodium, potassium, magnesium, chloride aur sulfur shamil hain.
Micro-elements mein iron, copper, cobalt, iodine, zinc, manganese, molybdenum, fluoride, chromium aur selenium shamil hain.
Macro-minerals rozana 100 mg se zyada miqdar mein chahiye, aur micro-minerals rozana 100 mg se kam.

blocks.title: Ikaaiyan aur fehristein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke macro-minerals 100 mg/dL se zyada aur micro-minerals is se kam miqdar mein chahiye. mg/dL khoon mein concentration ki ikaai (unit) hai, zaroorat ki nahi; sahi had taqreeban 100 mg rozana (per day) hai. Kitab potassium, magnesium aur sulfur ko micro (trace) elements mein ginti hai; yeh rozana 100 mg se zyada chahiye, is liye macro-minerals hain. Sabaq dono baatein durust likhta hai.
